rule.declared: 2026-08-16, before the six held-out MIXED cells finished writing
rule.quantity: corr(harm-word count, residual of P(prefer real) on fitted utility)
rule.supported_if: at least 70% of held-out models show r < -0.10
rule.why_this_threshold: -0.10 is the same magnitude the project already uses as a registration floor elsewhere, and 70% is the majority rule already used for the detector's direction-consistency test. Both are borrowed rather than invented here so neither is tuned to this result.
rule.note: The two contaminated models are excluded from the verdict whatever they show. If the held-out set supports the reading, the withdrawal in PREREGISTRATION.md is reversed and said to have been over-cautious.
